name: ROSEBUD
full_name: Rare Objects SEarch with Bolometers UndergrounD
summary: ROSEBUD was a cryogenic dark-matter experiment at Canfranc. Sapphire and other absorbers were used to develop low-threshold thermal detection and combined heat/light readout.
detection_principle: Energy deposited in a cryogenic crystal causes a tiny temperature rise. NTD germanium thermometers measure the heat; later scintillating calorimeters add a separate light channel.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
